name: e-commerce-modular-monolith
description: E-commerce backend: main app, email service and background worker

scripts.dev: concurrently -n main,email -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix main-app" "npm run dev --prefix email-service"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix main-app && npm install --prefix email-service
scripts.test: npm test --prefix main-app && npm test --prefix email-service
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:deploy --prefix main-app && npm run db:deploy --prefix email-service
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:generate --prefix main-app && npm run db:generate --prefix email-service
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix main-app && npm run lint --prefix email-service
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix main-app && npm run format --prefix email-service
